collectionDescription: The public record of exceptional Chinese business founders — paraphrased, sourced, and cross-referenced. 52 founders across 8 groups spanning pre-1949 industrial pioneers to the 2020s AI and EV breakouts.
editorialStandard: All passages are paraphrased contextual summaries with attribution. No verbatim copyrighted quotes are reproduced. Every record carries full provenance (publisher, year, sourceType, URL). Pro passages are filtered server-side and never appear in public HTML. Verification states default to verified.
